Overview

Our best-selling Dubai holiday packs the city's big sights into six relaxed days. You stay in a 4-star hotel, see the city from the Burj Khalifa, ride the dunes on a desert safari, dine on a Dhow cruise and spend a full day in Abu Dhabi at the Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque. Good for families, couples and first-time visitors.

Tour highlights

  • At the Top, Burj Khalifa (124th & 125th floor)
  • Desert safari with dune bashing, BBQ dinner and live shows
  • Dhow cruise dinner on Dubai Creek or Marina
  • Full-day Abu Dhabi tour with Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque
  • Free time for Dubai Mall, Gold Souk and Global Village (seasonal)
  • UAE tourist visa assistance

Day-by-day itinerary

Day 1 Arrive in Dubai

Fly from Mumbai to Dubai. Our representative meets you at the airport and transfers you to your hotel. Evening free; we recommend a walk around your hotel area to settle in.

Day 2 Half-day city tour & Dhow cruise

Morning city tour: Jumeirah Mosque (photo stop), Burj Al Arab view, Palm Jumeirah and the Atlantis, Dubai Museum area and the Gold & Spice Souks by abra. Evening Dhow cruise with buffet dinner.

  • Breakfast
  • Dinner
Day 3 Burj Khalifa & desert safari

Late morning visit to At the Top, Burj Khalifa, then free time at Dubai Mall and the Dubai Fountain. Afternoon pick-up for the desert safari: dune bashing, camel ride, henna, tanoura and belly-dance shows with BBQ dinner at the camp.

  • Breakfast
  • Dinner
Day 4 Abu Dhabi full-day tour

Drive to Abu Dhabi (about 2 hours). Visit the Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque, drive along the Corniche, see Emirates Palace and Qasr Al Watan from outside, and stop at Ferrari World / Yas Island for photos. Return to Dubai in the evening.

  • Breakfast
Day 5 Free day for shopping or optional tours

Day at leisure. Popular add-ons: Miracle Garden (seasonal), Museum of the Future, Aquaventure Waterpark or a Global Village evening. Ask us and we will book them for you.

  • Breakfast
Day 6 Depart for Mumbai

Check out after breakfast. Transfer to Dubai International Airport for your flight home.

  • Breakfast

Good to know

Best time to go: November to March for pleasant weather (20–30°C). Summer (June–August) is hot but hotels are cheaper.

Frequently asked questions

Is the Dubai visa included in this package?

Yes. We apply for your UAE tourist visa as part of the package. You need a passport valid for at least 6 months and a recent photo.

Can I upgrade to a 5-star hotel or private transfers?

Yes. Every part of this package can be upgraded. Call or WhatsApp us and we will send a revised price.

Is this package suitable for families with kids?

Very much. Most of the tours are family friendly, and we can add theme parks like IMG Worlds, Legoland or Aquaventure.
